74-76WINDS: Calm becoming East 5 mphA dry cold front passed through on Wednesday, increasing those breezes throughout the day. Temperatures Thursday and Friday will be slightly cooler as a result, with partly to mostly cloudy skies. Winds on Thursday will come from the northeast, sustained between 10 and 15 mph. There could be the occasional gust up to 20 mph. Friday will be mostly cloudy, but the weekend is looking fantastic! Some wet weather changes are possible heading into the start of next week. Be sure to stay with News4 for the latest weather information, both on-air and online. News4...
